The OpenAI Platform in Rings

OpenAI’s platform drawn as five rings around its models: the developer platform, built-in tools, the agent stack and the products people use. Each ring turns at its own speed. Hover a ring to hold it still, or tap any block to see what it does and where this site covers it.

Inner rings are closer to the model; outer rings build on everything inside them. The orange ring is one request travelling in to the model and back out.

Tap a block

Every block opens here with a short explanation and a link to the article that covers it.

Our own drawing of OpenAI’s platform, using the same five-ring layout as our Claude map so the two compare; not an OpenAI diagram. Items come from OpenAI’s announcements as recorded in this site’s lab-updates data; ⚠️ marks names or scope we could not confirm in OpenAI’s documentation. Rotation speeds are decorative. See also How OpenAI Evolved and the Claude rings. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic (an OpenAI competitor), helps write this site.
